owned_target_admission.scope: Point owned-root/compiler/exact-target-key check only; no argv/environment persisted, no global/private inventory or descendant/daemon emptiness claim

notice: Sampling, not hard quota. Shared-pool growth is not Nix-only or gross allocation. No target credit/hidden-free reconstruction. Leader wait does not prove descendant/daemon settlement; legacy /tmp is untouched.
command:
set -euo pipefail
export SNIX_BUILD_SANDBOX_SHELL="$1"
export NIX_CONFIG="${NIX_CONFIG-}"$'\nmin-free = 0\nmax-free = 0\n'
min_free="$(nix config show min-free)"
max_free="$(nix config show max-free)"
printf 'no-auto-GC shell: SNIX_BUILD_SANDBOX_SHELL=%s min-free=%s max-free=%s\n' "$SNIX_BUILD_SANDBOX_SHELL" "$min_free" "$max_free"
[[ "$min_free" == 0 && "$max_free" == 0 ]]
exec bash "$2"

no_auto_gc.inherited: Original NIX_CONFIG prefix preserved; only newline and the two zero settings appended; existing contents never logged

serialization: Parent enforces one monitor/one current leg in its serial Pueue group; Cargo lock is point evidence, not concurrency exclusion; SIGKILL of monitor leaves settlement unknown
